description: This file defines the PHP class StockStatus, which extends the Model class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. It contains methods for managing stock status data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving stock status records, descriptions, and their associated languages. The class interacts with the database and implements caching functionality.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Represents the stock status model for managing stock status data within the OpenCart localisation system.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Inserts new stock status entries for different languages into the database, returning the new stock status ID.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing stock status entry by its ID, including its descriptions across languages.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Deletes a specific stock status entry from the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all stock status descriptions associated with a given language ID.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific stock status by its ID for the current language.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of all stock statuses for the current language, with optional ordering, start, and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total number of stock statuses in the system for the current language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a given stock status ID across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all stock status descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a stock status in a specific language.
